\ell^{(1)} &= \operatorname{rowsum}\!\left(e^{S^{(1)}-m^{(1)}}\right)\in\mathbb{R}^{B_r},\\

m^{(2)} &= \max\!\left(m^{(1)},\operatorname{rowmax}\!\left(S^{(2)}\right)\right)=m,\\
\ell^{(2)} &= e^{m^{(1)}-m^{(2)}}\ell^{(1)}+\operatorname{rowsum}\!\left(e^{S^{(2)}-m^{(2)}}\right)=\operatorname{rowsum}\!\left(e^{S^{(1)}-m}\right)+\operatorname{rowsum}\!\left(e^{S^{(2)}-m}\right)=\ell,\\
\widetilde{P}^{(2)} &= \operatorname{diag}\!\left(\ell^{(2)}\right)^{-1}e^{S^{(2)}-m^{(2)}}\in\mathbb{R}^{B_r\times B_c},\\
